_description: Complete Niagara Particle Spawn module reference. Agent uses this to know which modules exist and what they do when building emitter stacks.
_source: UE5.6 Epic Documentation - Particle Spawn Group Reference

Initialize Particle.purpose: Set initial values: Lifetime, Position, Mass, Color, Sprite Size, Sprite Rotation, Mesh Scale
Initialize Particle.placement: TOP of Particle Spawn stack (always first)
Initialize Particle.vfx_usage: ALWAYS required. Every emitter needs this.

Initialize Ribbon.purpose: Set initial ribbon values: same as Initialize Particle + Ribbon Width, Ribbon Twist
Initialize Ribbon.vfx_usage: Use for trails, beams, ribbons, magic streams

Box Location.vfx_usage: Flat ground effects, rain spawn volumes

Cylinder Location.purpose: Spawn in cylinder with lathe controls
Cylinder Location.vfx_usage: Aura pillars, tornado base, ring effects

Skeletal Mesh Location.purpose: Spawn on bone/socket/triangle/vertex of skeletal mesh

Static Mesh Location.vfx_usage: Object burning, dissolve particles from surface

Rotate Around Point.purpose: Position on circle around center point

Add Velocity.vfx_usage: Most common - upward for fire/smoke, outward for explosion

Add Velocity from Point.purpose: Velocity from arbitrary point with falloff

Add Velocity in Cone.purpose: Velocity in cone shape with angle control

Apply Initial Forces.purpose: Convert forces to velocity at spawn
Apply Initial Forces.vfx_usage: Place AFTER force modules in spawn stack

Curl Noise Force.vfx_usage: ESSENTIAL for smoke, fire, magic - creates organic movement

Wind Force.vfx_usage: Environmental wind on smoke, embers, leaves

Color.purpose: Set Particles.Color directly with RGB + Alpha scale
Color.vfx_usage: Color over life curves, static color

Dynamic Material Parameters.purpose: Write to Dynamic Parameter node in Material Editor (4 floats per parameter, up to 4 parameters = 16 floats)
Dynamic Material Parameters.vfx_usage: Pass particle data to material: dissolve amount, erosion progress, custom masks

SubUVAnimation.vfx_usage: Fire, smoke, explosion flipbooks. Set frame count and animation curve.

Kill Particles in Volume.vfx_usage: Keep particles in bounds, ground plane kill

Spawn Beam.purpose: Place particles along bezier/line between points

Initialize Mesh Reproduction Sprite.purpose: Sample skeletal mesh surface for sprite reproduction
Initialize Mesh Reproduction Sprite.vfx_usage: Dissolve from mesh, mesh-shaped particle cloud

Sample Skeletal Mesh Surface.vfx_usage: Body fire, character aura, surface emission

Align Sprite to Mesh Orientation.purpose: Align sprite to mesh particle orientation

Initial Mesh Orientation.purpose: Align mesh to vector or rotate

Sample Texture.vfx_usage: Read texture data for particle behavior

Sample Pseudo Volume Texture.purpose: Sample pseudo volume texture at UVW

Sub UV Texture Sample.purpose: Sample single pixel in SubUV grid

World Aligned Texture Sample.purpose: Sample texture based on world position

Generate Location Event.purpose: Emit event with particle position, velocity, ID, age
Generate Location Event.vfx_usage: Trigger secondary emitters from particle positions

common_particle_parameters.Particles.MaterialRandom: Random value sent to material's Particle Random node
common_particle_parameters.Particles.DynamicMaterialParameter: 4-float vector sent to Dynamic Parameter node in material
